video_title: Got A Good One For You Guys…
evidence: SponsorRadar records KastKing sponsoring Intuitive Angling With Randy Blaukat's August 24, 2026 English-language YouTube video, with KastKing reel links and creator promo code Randy10. SponsorRadar shows 238 tracked KastKing sponsorships across 15 creators and reports that 52% of its last-12-month deals went to channels with 50K-250K subscribers. KastKing's official U.S. contact page separately invites collaborations, creative partnerships, and marketing inquiries at marketing@eposeidon.com, and its current terms confirm active affiliate, ambassador, creator, and influencer programs.
